abstract: The in vivo localising and clearance properties of conjugates of the folate-degrading enzyme carboxypeptidase G2 (CPG2) with anti-human chorionic gonadotrophin (W14A) were measured in nude mice bearing CC3 choriocarcinoma xenografts. Conjugates of W14A-F (ab')2 fragment coupled to CPG2 localised in tumour as effectively as native antibody alone but showed lower uptake in other major tissues. The clearance rates of conjugates prepared with intact antibody or F (ab')2 fragment were shown to be up to five-fold faster than for native antibody and two-fold compared to F (ab')2 fragment. Molecular weight analysis of residual conjugate in the blood showed that no degradation of conjugate to its component molecules occurred during circulation. It was concluded that F (ab')2: CPG2 conjugates offered the greatest potential for targeting applications.
abstract_ja: CC3絨毛癌異種移植を有するヌードマウスにおいて、抗ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)抗体(W14A)と葉酸分解酵素カルボキシペプチダーゼG2(CPG2)の複合体のin vivo局在および消失特性を測定した。W14AのF(ab')2フラグメントにCPG2を結合させた複合体は、天然抗体と同等に腫瘍へ集積したが、他の主要組織への集積は低かった。無傷抗体またはF(ab')2を用いた複合体の消失速度は、天然抗体より最大5倍、F(ab')2フラグメントより2倍速かった。血中残存複合体の分子量解析により、循環中に複合体が構成成分へ分解されないことが示された。以上より、F(ab')2:CPG2複合体が標的化への応用において最も大きな可能性を持つと結論した。
